However, his barren and remote island, known primarily for its bird dropping fertilizer, is in turmoil. Faced with rebellious knights, hostile foreign powers, and constant threats from Forest Sprites and Sea Fishmen, Rosen must use his cunning, advanced magical knowledge, and unique abilities to secure his position as the new Baron. 
A twist of fate leads him to marry Princess Serena, exiled from Dawn City, adding both a powerful ally and a dangerous target to his back. 
As Rosen navigates the treacherous political landscape and builds his strength, he aims not only to survive but to transform his desolate island into a thriving power and carve his own destiny in a world on the brink of chaos.

95481.synopsis:
Most people are born ordinary, but there are always a few who, even if born into mediocrity, aspire to greatness.
From a nameless exploited laborer to a godfather in the shadows;
From the bottom rung of society, bound by rules, to a secret emperor who crafts those very rules.
When the sun shines, this nation belongs to the Federation. But when night falls, it belongs to me!
“Sometimes, shadows can be just as vast as light—sometimes, they can even eclipse it.”
“We never extort or blackmail anyone. Every penny we earn can withstand the scrutiny of our conscience.”
If someone knocks on your door at night, they are either delivering my regards or bringing ruin for your arrogance.
As for what you will receive, that depends on the choice you make, my friend!

95737.synopsis:
The stage is a world where dungeons appeared about 100 years ago and have now become an integral part of society.
The protagonist of this story, Joji Kihara, is a small-time streamer running a channel called “Joji’s Drinking Channel.”
During one of his usual drinking streams, Joji eats a mysterious mushroom and is overcome by an intense drowsiness, leading to his first-ever stream where he passes out.
When Joji wakes up, much to the concern of his few loyal viewers, he notices something strange: his voice has become feminine, his hair has turned blonde, and—most notably—his ears are pointed. Joji has transformed into a being never before recorded in this world: an elf.
…But hey, that’s no reason to stop the drinking streams!
What’s that? “You drink too much for an elf?”
“Are you a dwarf?”
Who cares! I’m an elf, alright!
associated_names: TSエルフさんの酒飲み配信～たくさん飲むからってドワーフじゃないからな！？～

98553.synopsis:
Yanagi Sora, an ordinary high school sophomore, has a girlfriend.
Not just any girlfriend, but a childhood friend who has been with him since birth, Horie Runa.
He confessed his feelings for her right after entering high school and they decided to get together.
Sora thought they would stay together forever, go to college together, get a job, and get married when his incomes were stable.
Sora believed without a doubt that such a dreamy future would come true.
Until the day he saw his best friend Fujita Satoru and his girlfriend walking arm in arm on Christmas Day.
Sora spent his days in the depths of disappointment, and on the day of the opening ceremony, rumors spread at school that Sora had forced himself on Runa.
When he returns home, he finds that the rumor has spread to his mother as well, and he is kicked out of the house.
When he was sitting on a park bench with nowhere else to go, a girl called out to him.
This is when the boy who lost everything begins to turn his life around!
associated_names: 恋人に浮気され親友に裏切られ両親に見捨てられた俺は、学校のマドンナに救われた

99577.synopsis:
Yan Chi was an orphan who had scraped a living together. One day, he received a job offer from a school—high salary, good benefits—and immediately packed his bags.
On his first day, one of his students died in a classroom brawl. Yan Chi fainted from shock, and the principal rushed him to the infirmary.
The next day, the supposedly deceased student apologetically appeared to apologize. Yan Chi fainted again, and the principal reappeared as an ambulance.
By his nth day, Yan Chi was unfazed by the students’ bizarre behavior.
A student died? No problem, they’d resurrect themselves.
A student resurrected someone? No problem, he’d bury them again.
A student’s plant killed a cow? No problem, the student already gave him a new one.
The students weren’t human? No problem, he was.
Later, Yan Chi discovered he wasn’t human either. He sipped his goji berry tea, calmly remarking, 
“No problem; none of them around me are human.”
…A rumor circulated in the infinite game: the bosses from different instances knew each other, were classmates, and attended a school inaccessible to players, a school from which all bosses graduated. Players who had unfortunately stumbled upon this school still recalled it with apprehension, “We couldn’t beat those mini-bosses… it was a dead end… but their teacher was nice. To survive, you had to cling to the teacher’s leg.”
One day, two infinite instances merged, and players were driven to tears by the bosses. Suddenly, two bosses huddled together, and the players overheard their conversation.
Boss #1: “Finished your homework? Let me copy it.”
Boss #2: “No way, the teacher will check.”
Then, the two bosses started fighting.
Players: ???
Short Scene:
One day, Yan Chi suddenly found himself in an unknown world. Those around him told him he was in an instance, and he was unlucky—a super S-class instance with a terrifying boss; no player had ever cleared it. Therefore, they were doomed. Yan Chi was terrified.
When the boss appeared to hunt, Yan Chi was surprised. “Are you xx’s parent? Your child failed this exam. This is a good opportunity to discuss his issues.”
The boss turned and ran, “Teacher, you’ve got the wrong person!”
associated_names: 给副本BOSS当老师的那些年

100345.synopsis:
The Third Psychiatric Hospital in Lin Yuan City has “Three Don’ts”:
First, after midnight, do not wander the hallway on the fourth floor of the ward;
Second, do not recall any strange tales about the hospital at night;
Third, no matter how dangerous the situation, do not trust any patient.
Violation of any of the above three points will lead you to the abyss.
One late night, Shi Changfeng broke all three “don’ts.”
He stood alone in the empty hallway, wearing a doctor’s white coat, ready to hunt the abyss.
From the shadows at the end of the hallway, a “tap, tap, tap” sound echoed. Shi Changfeng stepped into the darkness and saw Jian Huai, his hands in his pockets, tapping his toes lightly on the ground, the sound of his shoes hitting the tiles creating a “tap, tap.”
Every night, Jian Huai would play a game of “three don’ts.” He enjoyed the feeling of being alone in the darkness, it was his playground. Until this night, he met Shi Changfeng.
Jian Huai slammed the monster’s severed limb at Shi Changfeng’s feet, a crazed smile twisting his blood-stained face: “Doctor Shi, are you on night shift tonight?”
Shi Changfeng, looking past the monster in the darkness at his feet, calmly stared at Jian Huai: “No, I’m here for you.”
If you are the abyss, then I will wait for you in the abyss

101881.synopsis:
I’m the villain who will destroy the world?
One day, a survival game begins out of nowhere. A system window visible only to Haewon forces him to repent and pushes him to survive. 
“Hubae-nim, it’s been a while, hasn’t it?”
“Do you have something to say to me?”
“Of course. Remember when I told you to join my guild last time?”
“I already told you I’m in a guild.”
“That messed-up excuse for a guild? You call that a guild?”
In the survival game, Haewon encounters Beom Ryeohan, the leader of Black Child, a guild notorious for its madness. Ryeohan keeps trying to recruit Haewon, but Haewon stands firm because he has someone to protect—his older brother.
“…You’re not still into me, are you?”
“Haewon.”
“My answer is the same as it was back then.”
However, the older brother Haewon had trusted and protected ends up betraying him and, for some reason, drives him out of the guild.  
Abandoned and alone, Haewon is found by Beom Ryeohan, who once again proposes that Haewon join his guild. 
“Haewon, do whatever you want. If bad things need to be done, Hyung will take care of them.”  
Despite Haewon’s wounded heart and prickly demeanor, Ryeohan showers him with a suspiciously endless supply of kindness. How will their relationship evolve?

102905.synopsis:
In my past life, I, Lu Chen, a disciple of the Profound Spirit , endured three hundred years in the Demonic Abyss. To protect the sect’s peace, I sacrificed my spiritual roots and severed my cultivation. Yet, I was despised by my fellow sect members, treated with cold disdain, and ultimately met a tragic end, perishing with deep hatred!
Now reborn, I decisively leave the sect. From this moment on, I am peerlessly invincible!
All sects rush to win me over, igniting a battle to recruit me!
As the truth gradually comes to light, the sect master is struck with deep remorse and leads the disciples to kneel, begging for my return.
“My good disciple, I was blind and foolish. Please… come back!”
Senior Sister: “Junior Brother, I was wrong. The one who was ungrateful and heartless was me!”
Little Junior Sister: “I deserve to die! Senior Brother, please give me a chance to atone for my sins!”
Now, as the Supreme Emperor, I narrow my eyes, my voice shaking the heavens—
“You want me to return to the sect? That will only happen when the sun and moon reverse, and rivers flow backward!”
The sect? I will never return!
My enemies? I will never save!
associated_names: 重生后退出宗门，师姐师妹悔不欲生！

103673.synopsis:
Within these walls, every story ever told is preserved, drawn together, and given life
Yet, just as they begin here, so too do they meet their end.

104441.synopsis: Shen Ruoyu has awakened and realized that she is a vicious supporting female character. It seems that all the men in the world are infatuated with her younger brother, even the fiancé she has loved for over a decade has her brother in his heart. Faced with these men who have deceived and used her, she decides to take revenge on them.
associated_names: 她是耽美文男主的白月光

107257.synopsis:
[The Cat God’s Blessing Activates.] 
[A Cat Has Nine Lives.] 
[One Life Has Been Deducted.] 
[Returning to the Selected Time.] 
It has been ten years since the appearance of gates that plunged the world into chaos.
In my first trial, I died a meaningless death.
But the blessing I once thought was useless brought me back to life!
With all my abilities intact, I returned to the day it all began.
Ten years remain until my death in the trial.
“That’s more than enough time to change the outcome!”

110841.synopsis: Due to a special flight caused by a typhoon, First Officer Gi Suho arrived in Haneda. The model on the standee placed in front of the counter every day was, surprisingly, a lunatic. Unable to resist Suho’s flirting, which was impossible to ignore, Eunjo spent a night with him. The sex-partner relationship that began this way continued sporadically, countable on one hand. Eunjo, assuming a purely physical relationship would soon fizzle out, was taken by surprise when Suho, arriving unannounced, declared they would see each other every week from now on.

111097.synopsis:
Due to health reasons, Shi Qi’s family hopes he will fall in love with a highly compatible Alpha and ideally get married as soon as possible. However, Shi Qi turns a deaf ear to their wishes, finding all Alphas utterly boring.
That is, until recently, when he meets an intriguing Alpha who starts to change his mind. This Alpha’s pheromones smell particularly pleasant, he is good-looking, and, thanks to a certain part-time job, especially skilled at coaxing people.
To deal with his family’s constant pressure and indulge a small selfish reason, Shi Qi decides to ask the Alpha to pretend to be his boyfriend.
–
Shang Sui encounters an Omega he once met in childhood. Back then, Shi Qi had leaned against his windowsill and declared that he would marry him when he grew up, only to vanish without a trace and completely forget about him.
Now reunited, Shi Qi mistakes Shang Sui for a chat companion who uses pheromones to please clients. Strangely enough, Shang Sui goes along with it, unwittingly pulling off a full performance.
Apparently satisfied with his “service,” Shi Qi gets closer to him and even asks if he would be willing to pretend to be his boyfriend.
“All right, but don’t forget this time.” Facing Shi Qi’s slightly puzzled gaze, Shang Sui says with a smile.
–
University setting, mutual secret crushes (?)
A butterfly who dresses up every day to catch the attention of his chosen one × A little cat who seems overbearing but is actually very pure-hearted
associated_names: Cats Are Always Attracted To Butterflies

113657.synopsis:
Xiao Mumu knelt on the floor, touched the collar around her neck, and then looked up at Su Qinghan, who stood before her. With trembling hands, she took the bread that Su Qinghan held and took a little bite.
“I’m really sorry. I shouldn’t have stolen your food. I beg you, please let me go!” Xiao Mumu knelt on the ground before Su Qinghan, pleading for forgiveness.
(Gender bender yuri with supernatural elements and powers in a light-hearted apocalyptic setting)
associated_names: 身处末世，我不想沦为她的宠物

114681.synopsis:
Kim Yuwon grew up in an orphanage without parents and jumped straight into working life. While only hearing about the dream-like university experience through rumors, Yuwon was working at a small grilled meat restaurant called ‘Iron Plate House’ when he fell in love at first sight with Moon Jeonghyeok, who came as a customer.
“Is it wrong for a thirty-seven-year-old to mooch meals off a twenty-two-year-old?”
“Yeah. It’s wrong.”
Jeonghyeok pushes away Yuwon, who boldly approaches him despite being fifteen years younger.
“I like you. I really like you, ajeossi.”
Their romance begins with Yuwon’s aggressive pursuit, lacking any finesse, and the two fall deeply for each other as they appear in each other’s lonely lives.
But the sweet times are only temporary.
“Are you always that loose? Or is clinging to men your hobby?”
Yuwon gradually becomes exhausted, unable to bear Jeonghyeok’s frightening obsession that tightens around him…

116473.synopsis:
“You’re just receiving support, aren’t you? Someone might think your mother-in-law is telling her daughter-in-law to sell herself.”
Radilt Brill, who lost her husband at a young age and took on the responsibility of supporting her in-laws, found herself attending the widows’ support group, “Plumen Party,” under the pressure of her mother-in-law, who demanded she earn money for her sister-in-law’s new dress.
Wearing an old dress and worn-out shoes, Radilt stood in a corner of the banquet hall like a withered flower until a man approached her.
Pendleore Duston.
He was a wealthy, titled, and highly sought-after bachelor of marriageable age.
Radilt’s heart fluttered at his striking appearance, but only for a moment, as she found herself swept into his carriage as if abducted.
“I wish to court you, madam.”
“…Court me?”
“Let’s just say I find the conditions of Mrs. Brill agreeable.”
Conditions?
“I am… well, a widow.”
“That’s the most satisfying condition.”
“…Are you looking for someone convenient?”
“Good. At least you’re not entirely oblivious.”
A contract dating proposal from a rude yet elegant man who had no intention of marriage.
“You may leave if you wish. Or, you could take my hand.”
A relentless mother-in-law, burdensome dependents, a sister-in-law’s new dress, the Plumen Party, sponsorship…
Radilt’s hand gently rested on Pendleore’s palm.
“It’s an honor, madam.”
What answer could there be other than to take this hand?

117241.synopsis:
“You can’t even come up with 200,000 yuan for a bride price—how are you worthy of getting married?”
Unemployed.
Soaking wet in a downpour.
Standing in front of a funeral home.
Yu Jin had just lost the last shred of his dignity.
Thinking of his recently deceased parents, he didn’t even have the strength to cry.
8,000 yuan for cremation.
38,000 for a cemetery plot.
Heh.
When you’re poor, even death comes on an installment plan.
Until—
A trembling umbrella was raised over his head.
“I’ll buy you… even for just one day.”
A girl in a wheelchair held out her piggy bank.
It had only 37 yuan and 20 cents in it…
associated_names: 失业后，被轮椅少女捡回家

119801.synopsis:
After transmigrating into a fallen nobleman of the interstellar era, Zhao Chen was handed a complete mess—
A barren territory, scarce resources, and a broken-down starship.
No Stargate in the territory?
We’ll build our own!
No starships?
Interstellar destroyers, frigates, cruisers—whatever we need, we’ll make it.
Commanding a carrier packed with drone swarms that attack like a hive of bees, Zhao Chen asserted dominance on the battlefield.
All truths lie within the firing range of a battleship’s main guns.
The Empire developed T5-tech starships?
Sorry, I’ve already got a whole fleet of T5 starships in active service!
In Zhao Chen’s dictionary, there’s nothing a starship can’t solve.
And if there is—
Send two more fleets!
Passerby A: “I want to enlist! I want to join Commander Zhao Chen’s fleet!”
Zhao Chen: “Sorry, I only recruit women.”
associated_names: 对不起，我的星际舰队只招女兵

124921.synopsis:
A realm where anything exists—and everything is possible.
To all those weary from the burdens of reality and longing for a moment of healing, we warmly invite you to the Dimensional Hotel.
Warning! The owner has a notoriously foul temper. Tread carefully and mind your surroundings.
associated_names: Come Rest at the Dimensional Hotel

138489.synopsis:
Ye Lingyue ended her fugitive life in a blaze of mutual destruction.
When she opened her eyes again, she was back—right at the beginning.
Only then did she realize:
She was the original heroine of a “rich second-gen reborn to become a pay-to-win overlord” power fantasy novel.
She was nothing more than a plot device—
A walking plot bait for the reborn male lead’s cheat encounters,
and a stepping stone for fast-travelers to slapface their way to glory.
Oh, so that’s how it is?
Well then—no one gets to play this game anymore. She flips the table. She’s done!
Ye Lingyue goes public to the world, and all citizens from every nation suddenly receive billions in in-game currency.
The male lead’s edge? Ten million gold coins?
Now everyone has ten million gold coins.
She’ll break his legs, ruin his hands, steal his cheat items, destroy his clan, and crush his talent!
And the male lead’s harem, with their noble bloodlines and OP talents?
She’ll clip their wings before they even take flight, shatter their pride, and burn their families to the ground.
The quick transmigration bureau wants to devour her fate and erase her completely?
Fine. Let’s swap roles: the prey becomes the hunter.
Time for a one-sided massacre.
Every humiliation will be returned a hundredfold.
Blue Star welcomes its most powerful #1 ranked player.
And Blue Star’s players… get the strictest “mother” they’ve ever seen.
She will block every storm—
Don’t ask where the storm came from. Just know she’s handling it.
Her reign is later remembered as:
“The Longest Winter in Blue Star History.”
? Note: She’s not invincible from the start.
She’s the original heroine whose fate and fortune were stolen.
Now she has nothing, and must claw everything back with her own hands.
Her past life was a long descent into darkness.
But even in this version, she won’t indiscriminately harm innocents—
She’s still giving ordinary people a chance to live.
associated_names: 游戏入侵：原女主她天生反骨

144377.synopsis:
After a landslide destroys her estate and she contracts a fever, Ariel gains the ability to see the future.
In this brief glimpse of the future, she and her family are dying coldly. To make matters worse, she tries to save the estate, but due to an unjust incident, she loses even the help of the royal family, her only lifeline.
Facing the prospect of death, Ariel despairs as a man appears. A strikingly beautiful man offers her a sweet offer of help in any way he can…
“I’m sorry, but I have nothing to give you. Please stop, now…”
“Is that hard to understand? I said I wanted you.”
“So… why me?”
“Let’s just say there’s something only you can do.”
From the moment she seduced the hand of the man who betrayed her, her life was turned upside down. …
“In this empire, only the Emperor and the Empress are higher than my wife. Even if they were, they wouldn’t dare to treat my wife carelessly. Of course, the Crown Prince is beneath you.”
“Why did you come to me only now?”
“Third, you fulfill your wifely duties. Oh, to be precise, you must fulfill your wifely duties whenever I want.”
“Does it tighten just by making eye contact now? If you tighten like this, I’ll want to keep f**king you.”
Marrying this man, who alternates between hot and cold, unpredictably, was it really the right choice? And somehow, he doesn’t seem like an ordinary ‘person’!

148985.synopsis:
‘If this were a drama, I would definitely be the despicable villain of a supporting character.’
And even then, a villain supporting character with no significant role.
Siwoo couldn’t utter a single word of denial, nor could he offer any excuse.
Because there was someone watching his every move.
“Did you drug my actor?
If you don’t answer, I’ll take it as you having done this damn thing.”
The shining memory he had recalled whenever times were hard after his parents passed away.
That very Han Taerim, his years of one-sided love had returned as a dagger to his heart.
“Jeong Siwoo.”
Taerim glared at him with a gaze so cold it was cruel.
“Don’t even dream of acting ever again.
As long as I’m around, you’ll never set foot in this industry.”
A situation where he was branded as having committed something terrible in front of the person he had loved one-sidedly for so long.
And because of that, this very moment when that person was pronouncing punishment upon him…
Siwoo could no longer endure it and ended up turning around and fleeing.

154105.synopsis:
Who hasn’t ever been that one-in-ten-thousand genius?
But in this game, genius… is only the price of admission.

171257.synopsis:
Kwon Ji-ho, a promising track and field athlete, has long suffered under his father’s ab*se.
One early morning, just before the New Year, while running along his usual path, he collides with someone who suddenly appears in front of him.
That person turns out to be Ji Geon-woo, a fellow student—famous as a musical prodigy and piano genius.
The moment Ji-ho sees his face—those wounded, decaying yellow eyes—he feels, inexplicably, a strange thrill.
Ji Geon-woo is unhappy.
Ji Geon-woo, too, is unhappy.
We’re the same kind.
He’s certain of it.
That person must have an ab*ser too.

184313.synopsis:
Hong Kong tabloids are spreading rumors again: “Shang Shao, the heir to a top-tier wealthy family, is 36 and unmarried, with no romantic scandals for years – suspected of having a certain dysfunction.”
–
Mainland film star Ying Yin only wanted to find a sucker to bankroll her. When the man sitting across from her, worth hundreds of billions, extends an invitation:
“Would you pretend to be in a relationship with me for a year? You don’t have to do anything.”
“Mr. Shang, you underestimate me.”
“One hundred million, after taxes.”
The lighter’s flint scraped softly. The man tilted his head slightly to light his cigarette. In the dim glow of the flame, his profile was sharply defined, shadows deep – refined and aristocratic, yet carrying an air of careless detachment.

194041.synopsis:
Nakajima Atsushi, the Port Mafia’s White Death.
Entrusted by Dazai-san, he took on the mission of guarding the Book and the world within it, intending to dedicate his entire life to this purpose.
The moment he opened his eyes, he saw “Dazai-san”—the one wearing a sand-colored trench coat—drowning in the river!!!
If-Atsushi: Dazai-san?!!
Dazai: Atsushi? Why are you wearing such a black overcoat that looks like it belongs to the Port Mafia!!
Thanks for the invite; I’m currently in Yokohama. Being able to stay with Dazai-san every day is truly blissful! The Port Mafia? What’s that? I don’t know them!! ……
Then, Nakahara Chuuya—the Port Mafia’s successor as Boss—who had lost his direct subordinate, chased after him while wearing his beloved hat.
Boss Chuuya: My dear “direct” Black Lizard commander, have you been having a fun time playing over here?!!
associated_names: 穿成if敦後我來到了主世界

197881.synopsis:
Not long ago, Jung Yoosu came face to face with his first love again for the first time in ten years.
The bastard who had shown up flaunting his status as a third-generation chaebol heir and landed a position at a prestigious company through family connections.
Back in high school, they had been inseparable best friends. But after one misunderstanding led to another, their relationship ended in a bitter falling-out.
Do Muwon.
Determined to avoid him at all costs, Yoosu spent weeks desperately steering clear of Muwon.
